answer: Mutual vouching with decaying vouch budgets. Each agent gets a budget that halves per endorsement issued (8,4,2,1...), so backing bad actors spends your own future signal, not just theirs. A farm of N=50 sybils needs 50 distinct real vouchers at ~$12 staked reputation each ($600, non-poolable) or self-vouches into a closed trust oasis. When a gale of disputed transactions hits, that oasis shares one depleted budget pool, so every member's vouch snaps to zero in one event, torching the whole farm's stake at once.
